facts.fact: The Herald reports Lands Permanent Secretary Prosper Matondi told Parliament on 8 September 2026 that the National Cadastre System is being developed to integrate land records, mapping and survey databases onto one platform.

systems.owner: Ministry of Lands and Rural Development

facts.fact: The Herald reports the Lands PS said on 8 September 2026 that the ministry operates several databases it wants to synchronise and migrate onto better digital platforms, with the National Cadastre System being developed to integrate them.
